shortBio.en: Fleetwood Mac vocalist from 1975; shawl-era harmonies and Rumours co-writes.
shortBio.zh: 1975 起 Fleetwood Mac 主唱；披肩时期和声与 Rumours 合写。

body.en:
Born 1948. Joins with Buckingham 1975. Dreams, Rhiannon, Landslide (solo-era fame too). Harmony stack with Christine McVie is Rumours glue.

Constant of Buckingham–Nicks commercial peak.
body.zh:
1948 年生。1975 与 Buckingham 加入。Dreams、Rhiannon、Landslide（独唱也成名）。与 Christine McVie 的和声叠层是 Rumours 胶水。

Buckingham–Nicks 商业峰值的常量。

whyHub.en: Buckingham–Nicks → Fleetwood Mac → solo: personnel bridge into Rumours-era radio craft.
whyHub.zh: Buckingham–Nicks → Fleetwood Mac → 独唱：通向 Rumours 时期电台工艺的人事桥。
